title: Objects, prototypes, and OOP — one screen
rememberThis: Objects are plain key-value bags with [[Prototype]] links — not CLR nominal types.
class is syntactic sugar: constructor function + prototype methods; extends wires the chain.
this is chosen at the call site (default, implicit, explicit, new, arrow) — detached methods break.
# private fields are real runtime privacy; TypeScript private erases in the bundle.
bullets: Property lookup: own keys first, then walk prototype chain until null.
Prefer composition (has-a) for services; shallow extends only for true polymorphic parse/handle families.
Object.assign and spread are shallow — nested objects still alias unless copied.
C# virtual dispatch uses fixed vtable slots; JavaScript uses mutable prototype lookup.
